facts.fact: 国家秘密行动局局长（兼任 CIA 人力资源副副局长）开口问下一位约见对象是谁。
facts.anchor: said the Director of the National Clandestine Service, who was dual-hatted as CIA’s Deputy Chief of Human Resources

facts.fact: 局长助理报出来者化名 Ignatius Q. HECKFETTER，局长立刻说 "Oh great. Dick Wacker."，识破是 Wacker。
facts.anchor: “Ignatius Q. HECKFETTER,” said his executive assistant.

facts.fact: MUCHADOO 命令 Wacker 别再讲 Funny Name，那套只适用于七楼以下，要他改口叫自己 Mr. DC/HR/DNCS，并把手从口袋拿出、摘掉帽子。
facts.anchor: “Cut that Funny Name shit. That only applies below the Seventh Floor. Call me ‘Mr. DC/HR/DNCS.’ Get your hands out of your pockets. And take off that stupid cover.”

facts.fact: 局长全名 Titus A. MUCHADOO，是海军陆战队黑帮（Marine Corps Mafia）成员。
facts.anchor: The DC/HR/DNCS, whose full Funny Name was Titus A. MUCHADOO, was a member of the Marine Corps Mafia.

facts.fact: 摩根县出身的 Junior Johnston 出版了一本未经批准的非虚构书《There's a Snake in My Boot!》，让中情局领导层出丑。
facts.anchor: published an unapproved nonfiction book called There’s a Snake in My Boot!

facts.fact: Johnston 把书的所有利润捐给了摩门教会，这几乎和书本身一样激怒海军陆战队黑帮。
facts.anchor: He donated all the profits from his book to the Mormon Church.

facts.fact: Wacker 解释 GOOWIKI 是他给「变革性人力资源全球外展计划」起的代号。
facts.anchor: That’s the name I’m using for the Transformational Human Resources Worldwide Outreach Program.

facts.fact: 会面收尾时 MUCHADOO 叮嘱这场对话从未发生，Wacker 回答 "Right, sir."
facts.anchor: “Okay good. Oh, and also, this conversation never happened, right?”
